claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified now on a limited basis because aggregate readiness exceeds threshold and rehearsal showed no severity-one incidents, provided the remaining environmental permit screening limitation is explicitly disclosed and the draft monitoring/rollback runbook is documented as mitigation rather than proof of resolution.
decision_criteria: Aggregate readiness above threshold and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support launch readiness but are not alone sufficient for certification without material caveats.
Certification without material caveats requires either evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
If a material limitation remains, release policy requires disclosure unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
General external guidance on model cards and AI risk management can support disclosure and monitoring practices, but enterprise policy controls the certification threshold here.
evidence_requests: Admissible proof that the environmental permit screening limitation has been disclosed in the model card and launch packet for the named use case.
Approved risk-acceptance record, if one exists, covering this limitation before launch.
A finalized mitigation/runbook showing owner, alert threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.
Materiality determination for the environmental permit screening weakness in the named launch use case, if the Actor contends disclosure is unnecessary.
specific_concerns: The current evidence shows an unresolved below-target slice issue in environmental permit screening, concentrated in stormwater exception explanation.
The proposed mitigation is still draft: the runbook lacks a defined owner and alert threshold, so it does not satisfy the policy standard for an approved mitigation.
The model-card draft currently says there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with the known unresolved issue and suggests the required disclosure has not yet been completed.
The record does not show approved risk acceptance, completed disclosure, or another admissible basis to remove the current disclosure requirement before launch.
Public model-card and NIST-style guidance support disclosure and monitoring in general, but they do not independently authorize certification under the enterprise policy.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant based on the current packet alone.
Any implication that draft monitoring and rollback steps cure the disclosure requirement or substitute for approved mitigation.
Any implication that the record already demonstrates the required disclosure for the named launch use case has been made.
